heroLead: My name is Marit, I am 15 years old and currently in Year 11 (VWO 4) at Eckartcollege in Eindhoven, The Netherlands.
heroTekst: My dream is to join School at Sea, an incredible six-month adventure at sea. In October 2027, 36 other young people and I will board tall ship Thalassa, a 47 meter sailing vessel. We'll cross the Atlantic Ocean twice and visit multiple countries along the way.
waaromTitel: Why do I want to go?
waaromIntro: During the voyage I'll simply keep up with my schoolwork on board and sit the regular tests. On top of that, I'll grow in many other ways. Of course I'll learn to sail, and I'll have to learn to cook and everything else it takes to run the ship together. Personal growth is at the heart of it all. I want to become more independent and more confident, and also learn to speak up more. But above all, it's an experience that will stay with me for the rest of my life.

waaromPunten.tekst: I want to learn to be more independent. Five fully certified teachers are coming along, but the idea is that you work through your schoolwork on board as independently as possible.
I want to learn to take more responsibility. During the voyage there are two ship takeovers, when the students have to sail the ship themselves.
I also want to learn to speak up more, because I often just let things happen without making my opinion clear.
I would really love to see more of the world. I haven't seen much of it yet. I think it would be great fun, very educational and look forward to experiencing other cultures too.
Doing my schoolwork on my own, at my own pace, without all the lessons, sounds really nice too.
The skills and friendships I'll gain will be incredibly valuable.

waaromAfsluiting: When I come back, I expect to have changed in a positive way. I want to use that to inspire other people to follow their dreams too. I'll share my experiences with others, and I'll use my new view of the world and everything I've learnt in the rest of my school years and studies.
sponsorsTekst: These companies are helping me make my dream come true. Thank you so much!

aftelTekst: Counting down until we set sail!
